default.notes: A visa from a Russian consulate is required before travel — tourist visas need an invitation or confirmed booking, and this nationality is not eligible for the unified e-visa.

groups.notes: Not eligible for the unified e-visa — a full consular visa with an invitation is required, and limited bilateral relations can make appointments and processing slow.
Eligible for the unified e-visa — apply online at evisa.kdmid.ru. Single entry, valid 60 days from issue for a stay of up to 16 days, usable only at approved border crossings.
Visa-free under CIS/EAEU arrangements — up to 90 days within any 180-day period.
Visa-free under a bilateral agreement — typically up to 90 days within any 180-day period; confirm the exact allowance with a Russian consulate before a long stay.
Visa-free under a bilateral arrangement for up to 90 days — confirm the counting rules (per visit or per 180 days) and any documentation requirements before a long stay.
Visa-free for up to 30 days per visit under a bilateral agreement.

RU.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Russian citizens.

BY.notes: Union State citizens — Belarusians may enter, live and work in Russia freely, with no routine border formalities on the Russia–Belarus land border.

UA.notes: Formally visa-free for up to 90 days, but since the full-scale war entry is heavily restricted — Ukrainian citizens may enter only via limited crossing points and face intensive screening. Travel is dangerous and not advised.

XK.notes: Russia does not recognise Kosovo or its travel documents — Kosovo passports are not accepted at the border, so entry on one is effectively impossible.

CN.notes: Visa-free for up to 30 days under the reciprocal trial waiver introduced in September 2025 — confirm it remains in force before travel.

HK.notes: Holders of Hong Kong SAR passports may enter visa-free for up to 14 days.

TR.notes: Visa-free for up to 60 days per visit, within a limit of 90 days in any 180-day period.

KR.notes: Visa-free for up to 60 days per visit, capped at 90 days in any 180-day period.
